instruction: Start in the middle of the large room head towards the door that leads to the outside, turn left and head up the stairs, take a hard left, stop when you are inside the workout room.

I'm facing the exterior door; I'll advance toward it, then turn left to locate the stairs.
I'm facing the glass exterior door. I'll advance toward it, then turn left to find the stairs.

I'm at the base of the stairs, which are slightly left of center. I'll turn left a bit and advance toward the staircase.
I'm at the base of the stairs, aligned with them. I'll climb the stairs, then take a hard left to find the workout room.

I'm at the base of the stairs which ascend to the left. I need to climb them, then take a hard left at the top toward the workout room.
